requirement_vague: Verify empty feed is returned when user follows nobody

omissions.description: The GET /api/articles/feed endpoint is entirely missing from the code. The requirement specifies that user1 (who follows nobody) should be able to GET /api/articles/feed and receive a response with articlesCount=0 and an empty articles array.
omissions.reasoning: Searching the entire codebase, there is no route defined for GET /api/articles/feed. The code has GET /api/articles and GET /api/articles/{slug}, but no feed endpoint. Without this endpoint, the scenario cannot be executed at all.
